name: E2E：模板匹配策略端到端测试 - 模型匹配×模板库×视觉×主图素材
description: 完整的端到端测试流程：配置Start节点(seller_id) → 添加模板匹配节点(模型匹配+模板库+视觉+主图素材) → 保存节点(验证"节点已更新") → 保存策略(验证"保存成功") → 试运行 → 验证运行结果

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer-open'); if (!drawer) return { ok: false }; const saveBtn = [...drawer.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === '保存'); if (saveBtn && !saveBtn.disabled) { saveBtn.click(); return { ok: true }; } return { ok: false }; })()

() => { const notices = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-message-notice, .ant-notification-notice'); for (const notice of notices) { if (notice.textContent.includes('节点已更新')) { return true; } } return false; }

(() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer-open'); if (drawer) { const close = drawer.querySelector('.ant-drawer-close'); if (close && close.offsetHeight > 0) close.click(); return { ok: true }; } return { ok: false }; })()

(() => { const desc = document.querySelector('textarea[placeholder*="策略说明"]'); if (desc) { desc.value = '自动化测试-模型匹配×模板库×视觉×主图素材'; desc.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } return { ok: true }; })()

() => { const notices = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-message-notice, .ant-notification-notice'); for (const notice of notices) { if (notice.textContent.includes('保存成功')) { return true; } } return false; }

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { ok: false }; const inputs = modal.querySelectorAll('input'); for (const input of inputs) { if (input.placeholder?.includes('seller_id')) { input.value = 'test_seller_model_1'; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return { ok: true }; } } return { ok: false }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { ok: false }; const buttons = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')); const runBtn = buttons.find(btn => btn.textContent.includes('单次运行') || btn.textContent.includes('运行')); if (runBtn && !runBtn.disabled) { runBtn.click(); return { ok: true }; } return { ok: false }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return null; const successMsg = modal.querySelector('.ant-message-success, .ant-alert-success'); const errorMsg = modal.querySelector('.ant-message-error, .ant-alert-error'); return { success: !!successMsg, error: !!errorMsg, successText: successMsg?.textContent || '', errorText: errorMsg?.textContent || '' }; })()
